description:
Prose and citation assertions over markdown artifacts move from the Rust test suite to the mechanical documentation gate.

## Background

`crates/jit/tests/fast_docs_templates/code_review_policy_test.rs` (357 lines, 14 tests) reads `AGENTS.md` and `contrib/gates/code-review-prompt.md` as text and asserts policy phrases in them. `test_packaged_qualified_item_citations_resolve_from_installed_registries` (`crates/jit/src/profile/repository_package.rs:299`) asserts that every `@/` citation in package content resolves from the registries the package installs — the property `scripts/docs-check-citations.sh` already checks as the `docs-mechanical` gate's M3 step over its configured footprint.

Two consequences follow. One property is proven twice, by two mechanisms in two languages. And a commit that changes only prose is gated by neither: the mechanical gate's footprint is `docs/`, and a prose commit does not run the Rust suite. Three documentation commits on this epic's planning bracket left the Rust suite failing on `main` until `ce053478` repaired it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No Rust test asserts the textual content of a markdown artifact.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every policy phrase `code_review_policy_test.rs` asserted is asserted by a committed checker the `docs-mechanical` gate runs.
- [hard] REQ-03: The packaged-citation resolution property is asserted once in the workspace, by the mechanical checker.
- [hard] REQ-04: The mechanical checkers reach `AGENTS.md` and `contrib/gates/`.
- [hard] REQ-05: Removing a required policy phrase, and adding an unresolvable `@/` citation to package content, each fail the gate; the demonstration is recorded.
- [hard] REQ-06: The change removes more lines of Rust than it adds.

## Notes

Not redo-record work, and excluded from the redo-record subtotal of the epic's REQ-06 line balance (`ER-01`): its Rust deletions must not be credited to the storage layer shrinking.
title: Documentation assertions leave the Rust suite
